card.name: Digits in ages and hour counts
card.fires_on: The digit 2 or 8 (or the word two) in a number just before a time unit such as hours, days, months or years. It appears in age cut-offs and spacing instructions in drug labels.

modes.label: Age cut-off
modes.description: The digit 2 or 8 completes an age threshold such as 28 days or 18 years.
modes.example: In patients older than 2<<8>> days of age, ceftria

modes.label: Hours before or after
modes.description: The digit 2 begins a time gap in hours around imaging or another drug.
modes.example: Discontinue short-acting somatostatin analogs <<2>>4 hours before imaging with Ga 6

card.writes: It favors counting nouns such as steps, rows and pages, and disfavors single time or distance units such as hour, minute and mile.
card.plain: It fires on the digits 2 and 8 in ages and hour gaps, such as 28 days or 24 hours.
